title: PDF Reader Test
one_sentence_summary: This text serves as a functional test to verify the parsing and extraction of a highlighted passage from a PDF page.
research_problem: Verification of a PDF reader's ability to extract and display highlighted text from a document page.
method_summary: Parsing a sample PDF page containing a highlighted test passage to confirm readability.
dataset_or_materials: A PDF page containing a highlighted text passage.
main_findings: The PDF reader successfully extracted the target text: 'PDF Reader Test The highlighted passage comes from a PDF page.'

section_map.heading: The highlighted passage comes from a PDF page.
